verdict.rationale: Bolna documents multi-step workflows with waits and retries, plus batch calling through the CLI. Neither is shown to run on a recurring schedule such as cron or periodic triggers. A one-off sequence with delays is an adjacent feature, not recurring job scheduling, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Build multi-step outreach sequences that combine voice agent calls, WhatsApp messages, API calls, waits and retries, driven entirely through the Bolna API.
